# `congress_party_control`

**Chamber party control and seat divisions by Congress**

House and Senate chamber party seat divisions and majority control intervals from official House Historian and Senate Historical Office history pages.

**Coverage.** Window. House initial-election divisions per Congress and Senate session/mid-session division changes from the 1st Congress through the current Congress as of the captured pages. *(measured 2026-11-25)*

- **Parquet file:** `congress_party_control.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `chamber` | `VARCHAR` | Legislative chamber (house or senate). |
| `congress` | `INTEGER` | Congress number. |
| `effective_from` | `DATE` | First date on which this chamber division interval applies. |
| `effective_to` | `DATE` | Inclusive end date of this division interval; null for an open current Congress. |
| `majority_party` | `VARCHAR` | Named organizing majority party; null when House plurality leaves no stated organizing caucus. |
| `majority_seats` | `INTEGER` | Seat count of the majority or leading party. |
| `minority_party` | `VARCHAR` | Named primary minority party. |
| `minority_seats` | `INTEGER` | Seat count of the minority party. |
| `other` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source text for minor-party or independent seats. |
| `vacancies` | `INTEGER` | Vacancy count where printed by the source; null when left blank. |
| `total_seats` | `INTEGER` | Total chamber seats reported for the interval. |
| `majority_basis` | `VARCHAR` | Rule used to determine majority control (such as house-seats-plurality, house-footnote, or senate-table-order). |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Official House or Senate history page URL supplying this row. |
| `printed_effective_from` | `DATE` | Raw effective start date printed on the source page before any documented mistyped-year correction. |
| `correction_reason` | `VARCHAR` | Reason for an applied printed-date correction, otherwise null. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained source HTML page. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC timestamp when the source HTML page was captured. |
